title: Construct ordered Al24O24N8 models
action: Construct three independent structural configurations (model 1, 2, 3) by placing eight N atoms into specific face-center anion groups of the spinel Fd3m structure (32e sites) to generate the models described for Al24O24N8.

title: DFT geometry optimization and total energy for Al24O24N8
action: For each model (1,2,3) run DFT geometry optimization and total energy calculation using GGA (PBE) and LDA functionals. After relaxation extract total energy, cell volume, and nearest-neighbour N–N distance.

title: Compile Al24O24N8 results
action: Write a CSV file containing, for each model and functional, the final total energy, equilibrium volume, and nearest-neighbour N–N distance.
description: Total energies, volumes, and N–N distances for the three Al24O24N8 models calculated with GGA and LDA.
output_schema: model (int 1/2/3), functional (string GGA or LDA), total_energy (float, eV), volume (float, Å³), d_NN (float, Å)

title: Construct Al23O27N5 vacancy models
action: Starting from the anion arrangement of the most stable Al24O24N8 model (model 2), substitute three N atoms by O atoms to obtain the Al23O27N5 composition. Generate seven distinct Al-vacancy configurations (model 1–7) corresponding to the sites and coordination environments described in the paper.

title: DFT calculations for Al23O27N5
action: For each of the seven Al23O27N5 models, run DFT geometry optimization followed by a band-gap calculation using GGA and LDA. Record total energy, volume, and band gap.

title: Compile Al23O27N5 results
action: Write a CSV file containing, for each model and functional, the total energy, volume, and electronic band gap.
description: Total energies, volumes, and band gaps for the seven Al23O27N5 vacancy models.
output_schema: model (int 1-7), functional (string GGA or LDA), total_energy (float, eV), volume (float, Å³), band_gap (float, eV)

title: EOS fitting for the most stable Al23O27N5 model
action: For the most stable model of Al23O27N5 (model 1), perform a series of DFT total-energy calculations at several volumes around equilibrium using both GGA and LDA. Fit the E(V) data to the Birch-Murnaghan equation of state to obtain equilibrium volume (V0), bulk modulus (B0), and pressure derivative (B′).

title: Report bulk modulus from EOS
action: Write a text file containing the EOS fitting results for GGA and LDA, including V0, B0, B′, and the percentage deviations from the experimental volume and bulk modulus.
description: Equilibrium volume, bulk modulus, and pressure derivative from Birch-Murnaghan EOS fitting, together with percentage deviations relative to experiment.
output_schema: For each functional (GGA, LDA): V0 (float, Å³), B0 (float, GPa), B_prime (float), DV_percent (float), DB_percent (float)

title: Elastic constants calculation for Al23O27N5
action: Using the most stable Al23O27N5 model (model 1), compute the elastic constants C11, C12, C44 with the energy-displacement method at the GGA level.

title: Report elastic constants
action: Write a text file containing the computed C11, C12, and C44 (GGA).
description: Elastic constants C11, C12, C44 for the most stable Al23O27N5 structure calculated with GGA.
output_schema: functional (string GGA), C11 (float, GPa), C12 (float, GPa), C44 (float, GPa)
